# Overrides applied when semgrep.txt is regenerated (uv pip compile --override).
# semgrep pins mcp==1.29.0 exactly (still true of 1.182.0), but mcp < 1.30.0 is affected by
# GHSA-84m7-p3x7-pcfv (unbounded session accumulation in the StreamableHTTP transport).
# semgrep imports mcp only for its MCP server, never for `semgrep scan`. semgrep.yaml installs
# the lock with --no-deps, so semgrep's own pin is not re-applied at install time.
# Drop this override once a semgrep release depends on mcp >= 1.30.0.
mcp==1.30.0

# semgrep pins the OpenTelemetry family to ~=1.37.0 / ~=0.58b0, but opentelemetry-api <= 1.45.0 is
# affected by GHSA-xcq7-p3pf-p88h (unbounded tracestate parsing). The whole family is moved in
# lockstep (opentelemetry-sdk 1.45.1 requires opentelemetry-api==1.45.1 and
# opentelemetry-semantic-conventions==0.66b1). semgrep uses OpenTelemetry only for opt-in tracing.
# Drop these overrides once a semgrep release allows opentelemetry-api >= 1.45.1.
opentelemetry-api==1.45.1
opentelemetry-sdk==1.45.1
opentelemetry-proto==1.45.1
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-common==1.45.1
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http==1.45.1
opentelemetry-semantic-conventions==0.66b1
opentelemetry-instrumentation==0.66b1
opentelemetry-instrumentation-requests==0.66b1
opentelemetry-instrumentation-threading==0.66b1
opentelemetry-util-http==0.66b1
